sub_strands.name: Sampling, Confidence Intervals, and Trends
performance_indicators: Formulate hypothesis tests and calculate confidence intervals for population means.
Deconstruct time series data to compute moving averages and isolate seasonal variances.
Apply bivariate linear regression models to predict socio-economic indicators.

sub_strands.name: World War Conflicts and League/UN Systems
performance_indicators: Analyze the systemic causes, alignments, and geopolitical consequences of World War I and World War II.
Evaluate the failure of the League of Nations versus the structural peacekeeping mechanisms of the United Nations (UN).
Assess Africa's diplomatic voice and voting patterns inside the UN Security Council.

sub_strands.name: National Budgeting and Audit Systems
performance_indicators: Deconstruct the formulation cycle of the Kenyan National Budget from sector hearings to allocation bills.
Evaluate the role of the Auditor General and Controller of Budget in ensuring fiscal accountability.

sub_strands.name: Ocean Configurations, Currents, and Karst Landscapes
performance_indicators: Map global ocean current loops and analyze their thermal impacts on coastal climates and fishing zones.
Explain the spatial evolution of subterranean drainage networks and limestone features (stalactites, stalagmites, dolines).
Design localized watershed protection strategies using remote sensing maps.

sub_strands.name: Global Manufacturing Hubs and Energy Mixes
performance_indicators: Evaluate factors driving spatial distribution variations across major industrial corridors (e.g., Ruhr Valley, Great Lakes region).
Analyze transition dynamics of renewable energy configurations within developing economies.

sub_strands.name: Rule of Law, Administrative Law, and Treaties
performance_indicators: Analyze judicial review applications filed against arbitrary administrative decisions by state organs.
Deconstruct the enforcement hurdles of regional treaties within domestic statutory boundaries.
Evaluate alternate dispute resolution (ADR) paths including arbitration and judicial mediation configurations.

sub_strands.name: Fiscal Regulations and Global Trade
performance_indicators: Evaluate the structural impact of regional customs unions and tariffs on cross-border logistics.
Analyze corporate taxation structures and regulatory compliance workflows for multinational entities.

sub_strands.name: Legal Research and Logical Frameworks
performance_indicators: Draft rigorous policy position papers using objective terminology and logical cross-citations.
Map and expose structural circular arguments and false equivalencies within complex legal documents.
